title: You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection
blurb: Framed detection as one regression from the image to a grid of boxes and class probabilities, running in real time with a single network pass.
intro: YOLO divides the image into a grid; each cell predicts a few boxes with confidences and one class distribution, and everything is trained with a weighted sum-squared loss. At test time, class-specific scores are thresholded and duplicates removed with non-maximum suppression. The steps build IoU, box encodings, NMS and a modern box-regression loss; the capstone is the YOLO v1 training loss.

steps.name: Generalised IoU loss
steps.note: What later YOLO versions use instead of squared error on coordinates.
